funds.name: 水牛二號生技基金 (Water Buffalo II, Biotech)
水牛三號生技基金 (Water Buffalo III, MedTech/Digital Health)
TaiAx Life Science Fund L.P. (JV with Axil Capital, Tokyo)

strategy.thesis: National-level VC co-founded by Taiwan's National Development Fund; biotech funds target small/large-molecule new drugs, regenerative medicine, medical devices, cell & gene therapy, digital and precision health across Taiwan and North America. TaiAx (with Tokyo's Axil Capital) focuses on rare disease, gene/cell therapy, AI medical products and first-in-class drugs.

summary.en: Taiwania Capital is Taiwan's national-level VC (founded 2017 by the National Development Fund and private institutions). Its biotech vertical runs the 'Water Buffalo' II (NT$5.901B, 20 biotech portfolio companies) and III (NT$1.641B, medtech/digital health) funds, plus the 2024 US$200M TaiAx Life Science Fund JV with Tokyo's Axil Capital targeting rare disease and cell/gene therapy.

summary.en: Diamond BioFund (TPEx-emerging 6901, listed July 2022) is one of Taiwan's first large dedicated biotech VCs, founded 2013 with NT$5 billion registered capital and chaired by Lu Kong-ming. strategy.thesis: Taiwan's oldest and largest private-equity/VC brand (founded 1959). Its second NT$ biomedical fund (Dec 2020, NT$3.11B target) deploys 60%+ into Taiwan targets across biotech pharmaceuticals (incl. cell & gene therapy), medical technology, digital healthcare and services, using a 'nine-box' early-plus-growth framework.

summary.en: CDIB Capital Group (founded 1959, KGI Financial) is Taiwan's leading PE/VC house. Its biomedical line runs the 2014 NT$1.75B Fund I and the December 2020 NT$3.11B (target) Fund II, deploying 60%+ into Taiwan across new drugs, cell & gene therapy, medical technology and digital health.
